About

Welcome! We opened shop in Fordham’s Biology department in the fall of 2024, where we are using quantitative and molecular genetics approaches in the nematode to investigate natural variation in DNA damage response.

Feel free to reach out if you are interested in joining our group. (Please do not use AI in any part when writing your inquiry, thanks.)
